description: Free-text search across DEX pairs on all major chains. Returns the top matches ranked by liquidity with price, liquidity and 24h volume. 0.002 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

q.description: Token name, symbol or address, e.g. bonk

name: dex_search
